Resolves #21568

The hero's canvas now draws what its sentence says. `Neo.canvas.RoundTable`, an engine scene with its host `Neo.app.roundtable.Canvas`, replays a record: named seats in their model family's colour around the statement, a door where outside contributors enter, a merge seat, review chords, a change request that knocks its item back, and one square per merged pull request in a dated seven-day strip. The Portal feeds it `record-week.json`, which `buildScripts/docs/recordWeek.mjs` writes from the public API. `Portal.canvas.HomeCanvas` (1,148 lines) is deleted; the engine half is 1,807 lines, 989 of them code (`check-file-sizes`: the scene 860, its host 129).

Evidence: L3 (local: unit specs, an e2e spec against the dev-mode page, frames) → L4 required (AC-12, the deployed production build). Residual: AC-12, Residual-Owner: #20682.

agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline checks ran locally (class module scope, JSDoc types, front door fingerprint, fixed sleeps, engine brain boundary, whitespace, content root derivations, package contents, file sizes, relative links, class hierarchy freshness). Change class: capability.

Intake (self-authored this session, stage 2 only): Prescription checked: `src/canvas/Base.mjs` — owns the concern (a 2D scene on the canvas worker; `GraphScene` is a WebGL point-and-line scene whose camera takes drag and wheel). Prescription checked: `src/app/SharedCanvas.mjs` — owns the concern. Prescription checked: `buildScripts/docs/captureExamples.mjs` — owns the concern (a Portal data generator).

## Deltas from ticket

- `quietIds` became `blockIds` and `bandIds`: the headline's box spans the whole table, so it keeps seats out of its rows without being erased. The ticket's body carries the change.
- The scene lays itself out around the statement its host names; the host no longer hands over the ring's place.
- The table stands only where every seat fits with its name. Elsewhere the strip stands alone: at 900×700 and on a phone (the ticket said "under 700 px").
- The host loads a record from `recordUrl`, and measures the statement again when one of its components changes size: a web font that arrives late wraps the sentence anew.
- A day's running count stands beside its name, and the replay's clock beside the day it is in. The record names its `unit`; the caption opens with how many items have landed in it (`180 / 301 pull requests merged, one square each`), so a strip half full reads as a replay under way.
- The scene is erased under the statement's whole column (`calmOf`), not under each box alone: a chord left stubs between two lines.
- The strip's squares step down to 5 px (`measures.floor`) before the room under it shrinks, and go below that only where nothing larger stands (the table under Test Evidence).
- A caption too long for its room keeps the window's dates: its last parts go first, then what a square is, then the unit.
- A palette may name how opaque its chords are; the Portal's light palette does (`chord: 0.9`).
- `learn/guides/advanced/NeuralSwarm.md` teaches the deleted renderer: out of scope, noted in #21580 (mine, blocked by this ticket).

Kept: a merge seat further down costs the strip a row at this height.

## Cold look

The author's read as a stranger, at a glance: a statement, and around it named people in three colours handing work to each other; a dated strip filling up; a legend that says Claude, Gemini, GPT and Contributors; a caption with 301 pull requests, 469 reviews and 136 change requests. The picture says the sentence above it. By the front-door test: a decider sees what the institution produces in a week and that its reviews bite; colour carries meaning, the things are connected, and the frame is dense at rest.

Two zero-context reads of the dark frame, one helper each, ten seconds, no context:

- **Read 1, on `e5e6db362f`: 6 of 10.** Unprompted it named the twelve labelled dots, the day columns, the legend and "301 pull requests merged · 469 reviews". Asked, it read the names as the sentence's "persistent AI maintainers", their colours as Claude, Gemini and GPT, Contributors as outside people and `@tobiu` as one human. Defects of the scene: a chord cut through the headline "like a scratch" and left stubs at the button; the day counts (180) seemed to contradict the caption (301); nothing said what one square counts. Fixed in `a2bd22dd49`.
- **Read 2, on `98eb9e3d58`: 6 of 10.** "The names plus the squares read as a live activity display for some team." No line touches the headline, the sentence or the buttons; "one square is one merged pull request"; the day totals add up to the caption's 180. Left: a chord that followed its item into the strip, "like a glitch hanging off that button" (fixed in `8795b3883e`); the stray-mark reading above; the strip's words are small.
- **Why 6, twice:** the headline phrase on screen ("Conversational UIs") and the sentence ("agent institution") describe different things, and the sentence is the dimmest text of the centre. "The pull comes from the visuals rather than the message." That is the hero's own copy, outside this leaf (ADR 0018, #20682).
